text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Another year has passed, and with it, more
races and racers have
made their way into
racing history.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
In addition to her award, this Umamusume
has also received a special
set of racewear
to commemorate this occasion.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we shall move on to the main
event. Welcome to the URA
Awards
Ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay, time to get dullsville here to make
some noise...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Don't even think about it! This is not the time or place!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but I understand the desire to
celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If we were at the racecourse, we'd be
drowned out by the crowd's
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! "Waaah! I'm so happy for youuu!" I
can totally see the stands
bursting into
tears and cheers!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Spe's received plenty of cheers like that
already.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Spe's received plenty of cheers like that
already.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's so strange to think about.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When I first met her, she was a helpless
Umamusume who had lost her
way to the
school after just arriving from
Hokkaido...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, she's grown into a
fine racer. But a lot certainly
happened in
that time.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now we'll introduce our awardee. For
her achievements and
contributions to the
racing world, we present this award to...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Team Sirius's own Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I am S-S-S-Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your award. Could we
ask for a few words?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-sure!
I am truly honored to have received
such a prestigious award!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look at her shake in her boots...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale... Um... I also want to say...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Getting where I am today involved a lot of
people and experience,
each one just as
important as the last.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This all started with a dream I inherited
from my moms, and along the
way, I've run
with many friends—my racing rivals.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it wasn't always an easy
journey. At times, the hills felt
extra steep
and the road extra muddy. I could have
slipped at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But whenever I faltered, my trainer was
there to offer their support.
They showed
me the path I needed to take.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Together we took on each obstacle one at
a time, and before I knew
it, I was the
racer I am today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I may not be able to meet all your
expectations, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I want to be a racer that brings you hope—one that can show you that your wildest dreams can come true!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My heart is pounding,
but I can't tell if it's
from nerves or excitement.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way. We're finally running
together, after all!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This is our long-awaited showdown... Let
us give it our all, and leave
no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We'll give our all—no holding back!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
As the best in Japan, I run carrying the
dreams of many!
